name: Gwen Darrow
source: A seventh-year student belonging to the House Ruachan. One of the golden children of the school, she one of Tír na nÓg's top duelists and a star player of Lasracha. She is open and daring, and prefers to solve her problems head-on.
translation: A seventh-year student belonging to the House Ruachan. One of the golden children of the school, she one of Tír na nÓg's top duelists and a star player of Lasracha. She is open and daring, and prefers to solve her problems head-on.
